description: One data row of person/{person_key}/comparison.csv, read as an object of column name to cell text; an empty cell is null. The header row must be exactly the columns of x-columns, in that order. Generated from meterline_gold/write.py and meterline_gold/dataset_docs.py by meterline_gold.contract; do not edit by hand. Meaning of each column: docs/reference/gold-datasets.md and the gold spec, sections 6 to 8.

compare_cell.description: Comparison cell id: the compare_by attributes and their values.

comparison_band.description: Where the person sits against the published cut points of their comparison cell.

hidden.description: True when a privacy rule withheld at least one covered value of the row; empty values then mean withheld.

schema_version.description: GOLD_SCHEMA_VERSION of the build that wrote the file; the same on every row.

title: gold-dataset-comparison
x-cost-column-rule: `own_cost_ref` is the person's own `cost_ref`; there is nothing to add across rows.
x-grain: One row per month: the person's own cost and band.
